## Why

ADR-155 registered `sig.workspace-state/2` as the T2 state contract
while `/1` still shipped: a hardcoded parameter list, `view=network`
as the explorer's name, no `at=` frame, no canonicalisation receipts,
no "cite this view", and no uniform rule that an unapplied parameter
is visibly named. This row lands the `/2` contract on all three T2
surfaces without a route re-type or a new dependency.

## What ships

### The registry (`web/src/lib/workspace-state/`)

- **`registry.ts`** — `sig.workspace-state-registry/1`: every
  supported parameter with its type, cardinality, default, vocabulary
  constraints, legacy aliases/normalisation rules and per-surface
  application metadata. One table drives everything downstream.
- **`state.ts`** — v2 parse/serialise/canonicalise with v1 compat:
  `v=1` links resolve identically (v1 value semantics; `/2`-only
  parameters reported, never interpreted); new links mint `v=2` in
  canonical order with defaults omitted. `bbox`/`frame` fold into the
  canonical `at=` frame; `kind=site`→`type=record`,
  `US-OK`→`iso3166-2:US-OK`, `view=network`→`graph` and
  `location=any`→absent all land with **visible receipts** naming the
  facet that moved. Unsupported versions and invalid values refuse
  loudly.
- **`conformance.ts`** — the surface × facet harness: each T2
  surface's `APPLIED_PARAMS`; a received parameter it does not apply
  earns a `role="status"` `data-testid="facet-not-applied"` notice
  (the map parses and announces `at=` — its application stays with
  the map-state row).
- **`cite.ts` + `CiteThisView.astro`** — "cite this view" mints
  release-pinned `/s/<pub>/<surface>/?v=2&…` links as copyable text
  under the J3 §8.1 interim wording until TX-13b.

### Wiring

- `islands/workspace.ts` — the sole DOM/history adapter parses and
  emits v2 (pushState/replaceState, popstate re-parse); the three
  islands import through the v2 barrel while `/1`-era helpers stay
  re-exported.
- `ViewSwitch.astro` — cross-surface links carry `v=2` state.
- `BaseLayout.astro` — T2 documents carry unconditional
  `noindex,follow` plus the base canonical (a static build cannot
  split parameterised heads).
- `astro.config.mjs` — the sitemap lists registry-derived canonical
  T0/T1 routes only; `noindex` and non-canonical URLs excluded.
- `page-types.ts` — T2 contracts move `sig.workspace-state/1` → `/2`;
  the `/1` module stays for the /1 contract's own tests.
- No-JS equivalents + expanded named state notices on all three T2
  routes.

### Tests

- `tests/unit/workspace-state-v2.test.ts` (31 legs): schema, v2
  canonical serialisation, v1 round-trip, every canonicalisation fold,
  loud refusal, the full conformance matrix.
- `tests/e2e/workspace-v2.spec.ts`: v2 deep links on all three
  surfaces, the `bbox`→`at=` "map viewport" receipt, `kind=site`
  result-type naming, facet-not-applied notices, the cite affordance,
  robots/canonical meta, sitemap contents.
- `workspace.nojs.spec.ts` updated for `v=2` static links;
  `page-types.test.ts` registry completeness.
